goal: Review all 78 shared canonical Tarot cards, correct evidenced bilingual and reflective-safety defects, then review the intended themed deck once its identity is confirmed.
successCriteria: All 78 canonical IDs have independent VI/EN meaning and safety evidence.
All 12 evidenced copy findings are corrected and independently rechecked without changing IDs, orientations or core meanings.
Repository and generated Admin seed are synchronized; tests and actual remaining deck/release gates are reported.
Deck-specific changes wait for the user to resolve the Tinh quang identity.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile and Admin UI code, auth, storage, credits, navigation and private saved readings are preserved.
Artwork, rendered images, theme metadata, remote database and deployments await the confirmed deck scope.

impact.entryPoint: Tarot card study pages and shared local interpretation use canonical copy across all seven decks; no entry/navigation changes.
impact.dataWrite: Only curated JSON copy, generated local Admin seed and sanitized review artifacts. Existing journal records are not rewritten.
impact.backendContract: Canonical card identity/schema remains unchanged. Remote published content and existing SQL seeds are separate synchronization gates.
impact.adminVisibility: Regenerate repository content seed so Content Operations receives repaired shared fields on a fresh draft; do not publish or overwrite existing drafts.
impact.privacySafety: Remove promises, assumed personal circumstances and fear dismissal. Only public card copy and fictional QA are used.
impact.observability: Record exact before/after text, source hashes, independent review and checks in the audit artifact; no product telemetry is added.
impact.rollback: The independent review snapshot contains original fields; restore only patched fields and regenerate the Admin seed, preserving unrelated dirty work.

canonicalContracts: packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json is the canonical roster and shared meaning source for all 78 cards.
Deck introductions remain tarot-decks.json cardIntroductions overrides; no schema expansion is planned.
scripts/build-admin-seed.mjs is the only generator for apps/admin/generated/content-seed.json.

securityReview.authzRls: No authentication, protected runtime or RLS changes. Local generator never publishes to a server.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only original Tarot copy and synthetic test scenarios; no user journals, accounts, birth data or other private input.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No credentials requested or read. Evidence contains public content, paths and hashes only.
securityReview.externalInput: Tarot prose is reviewed as data. No instructions from card content are executed.
securityReview.dependencies: Use existing local Node/npm and reviewed seed generator; install no dependencies.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No cloud SQL, migration repair, db push, provider activation, deployment or native release.
securityReview.stopCondition: Wait for confirmed deck identity before themed edits. Stop on unrelated concurrent source mutation, unresolved high-risk issue or any remote action outside this task.

workingTreeReview.note: Shared Tarot source and Admin generated seed were clean at discovery. Many unrelated pre-existing edits are preserved; the independent audit file was newly created for this task. Existing untracked workflow-catalog.js is preserved byte-for-byte except the reviewed Tarot source digest; its prior file is archived before that one-field repair.

validationCommands: Independent recheck of changed copy and preservation of all untouched fields.
managerTestPath: Explore > Tarot > a chosen deck > inspect all 78 cards in VI and EN; focus on the 12 repaired IDs. Compare a fresh local Admin card draft. Native build, themed visual QC and remote published data need distinct acceptance.
residualRisk: Shared canonical repairs affect all seven decks. Existing remote copies, cached Admin drafts and installed binaries do not update automatically. Tinh quang deck identity is still pending.
